firstTokenTimeout.rootCause: Requests exceeded the 2500ms first-token deadline. Contributing factors: (1) 2500ms deadline was tuned for primary Groq without accounting for Gemini fallback latency variance; (2) gemini-3.5-flash reasoning token latency (~1940ms) easily pushed TTFT over 2500ms under slight load; (3) burst requests in Batch C saturated the standard 15 RPM queue window at Google, causing upstream queuing delays between 2831ms and 5292ms.

quotaExhaustion.note: Manifested as upstream queuing exceeding first-token deadline rather than explicit 429 body
